title: Mapping simplex of a finite chain and its induced map
statement: Use small simplicial sets [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For $n\geq0$, a chain is a functor $[n]^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$, written $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$. Define $M(A)_r=\coprod_{\alpha:[r]\to[n]}(A_{\alpha(r)})_r$. For $\theta:[s]\to[r]$, its operator sends $(\alpha,a)$ to $(\alpha\theta,t_{\alpha(r),\alpha\theta(s)}\theta^*a)$, where $t_{j,i}:A_j\to A_i$ is the chain transition. For a natural transformation $f:A\to B$, its induced map $M(f):M(A)\to M(B)$ sends $(\alpha,a)$ to $(\alpha,f_{\alpha(r)}(a))$ in every degree. These are the mapping-simplex construction and its map on chains.
